text: The letter says you got in. You read it twice to be sure.
You pack the last box. The rooms echo now.
He took credit for your work in front of everyone, again.
Footsteps behind you have matched your pace for three streets.
You lift the lid and something moves in the pan.
You open the door and forty people are standing in your living room.
The lake is flat. Nothing is due today.
Your flight is delayed three hours. The wedding starts at six.
She reads your name from the list and the room turns to look.
You realise you sent it to everyone, not only to her.
The same three notifications have sat there since Tuesday. All automated.
Boarding opens in ten minutes. You have not slept.
